name: GET /api/leadflow/go-live/status - the readiness gate
description:
Seven readiness checks, COMPUTED FROM FACTS on every read.

A STORED READINESS FLAG SAYS "READY" FOR AS LONG AS NOBODY UPDATES IT, which is exactly how a launch happens with an unpublished offer and no calendar connected. Every check here is a query against current state.

FAILING CHECKS ARE NAMED. "Not ready" is not an instruction; "no offer version is published" is something one person can go and fix. QA: measured live returning ready:false blocking on open escalations and open incidents.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
